subject: ADR-186: the charts, read (4) -- the lab's terrarium stream and theory-bench model held to ports of the page that draws them; the transcribed tiles written by the port; lab drawings under the cap unheld 3 -> 0
body: THE TERRARIUM AND THE THEORY BENCH. The lab's two seeded-stream charts and its model curve were the last drawings under the reader's cap no task held; the terrarium's tiles (J' 0.73, 616/604 ...) were transcribed from the page when the task was written. tools/verify/_lab_models.py (new) ports runMeadow and runIsland over tools/mulberry32.py -- the generator the determinism shim is already held to -- with Shannon, Chao1 and the evenness sentence, and runTheory for all six models exactly as the page states them. verify_eco 165 -> 194 holds the live page's tiles, readings and both charts at every slider setting the task visits, and the theory chart and its reading for seven model/habitat cases; page-ecology-lab-science 263 -> 337 holds the terrarium charts at boot/uneven/even/island and the theory chart at logistic-again/competition/still, every literal written by the port and held to it by the suite (the `still` curve is the default to K 120: the import restores the neutral habitat). Twenty-one hand mutants across page, port and task, all killed at the named check. No page was edited. Also: verify_cs_science's webfont filter accepts ERR_TUNNEL_CONNECTION_FAILED, a proxied container's spelling of the unreachable CDN (84/86 -> 86/86 here; no page change).
